annotations.title: Show a guitar scale on the fretboard

description: Gives the notes of a scale in any key and where they fall on the guitar fretboard (standard tuning), string by string, with root notes marked. Scales: major, natural minor, harmonic minor, melodic minor, the seven modes (dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, locrian), minor pentatonic, major pentatonic, blues and major blues.
name: get_scale
title: Show a guitar scale on the fretboard
